description: Invented tiny emission matrices for scripts/test-alignment-core.py. Scores are integers (exact in float32); "-inf" is an impossible emission. Expected results were enumerated by hand and match the WhisperX 3.8.6 functions.

cases.note: At frame 1 stay and change tie at -2; stay wins. The other tie choice would give spans [1, 2], [2, 3].
Two identical labels in two frames: allowed here, impossible for full CTC.
Staying scores the blank, so the path ends after frame 0; frame 1 is not scored. Full CTC would give the token both frames.
Rows 1 and 2 of the last column tie at 0; the earliest end wins.
